answer: Deposits are visible in prism, and island reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 50 aliases, and each one needs its own funded lotus account. A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 5 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
